archive: La Jolla Covering Repository final archive
method: Index records for the listed (v,k) were recomputed with coverlib.frontier.candidate_frontier over {existing index witnesses} U {raw LJCR record cover (1-based -> 0-based)} U {best fixed-b refined witness}; every other index record is byte-for-byte unchanged. No witness file was deleted or overwritten.
refinement_driver: software/tools_rebalance/rebalance_one.py (stages: coverlib.balanced.improve_pair_balance, coverlib.residual.exact_neighborhood_repair, driver swap search, coverlib.refinement.improve_item_balance + coverlib.expansion.neutral_item_walk; strict fixed-b key acceptance)
